title: Cayenne Goes Electric: Porsche Unleashes a 1,140 HP Beast in Malaysia
summary: Porsche has officially launched the all-electric Cayenne in Malaysia, marking its third EV offering in the country. This high-performance SUV boasts up to 1,140 hp, over 600km of range, and starts from RM699,000, significantly expanding Porsche's electric footprint.
content:
Porsche has officially electrified the luxury SUV segment in Malaysia, unveiling the all-new Cayenne Electric. This isn't just another addition to their lineup; it's a statement, representing the brand's third fully electric vehicle to hit Malaysian roads, following the groundbreaking Taycan and the recently introduced Macan EV.

Underneath its sleek, unmistakable Porsche facade, the Cayenne Electric is a veritable powerhouse. While specific variants and their corresponding power figures are yet to be fully detailed for the local market, the global unveiling promises models capable of unleashing an astonishing 1,140 horsepower. This level of output doesn't just promise blistering acceleration; it guarantees a driving experience that redefines what a performance SUV can be, blending the practicality of a family vehicle with the heart-stopping thrust of a sports car.

Beyond raw power, range anxiety becomes a relic of the past with the Cayenne Electric. Drivers can expect an impressive cruising range of over 600 kilometers on a single charge, making long-distance journeys a breeze. This substantial range, coupled with Porsche's commitment to fast-charging infrastructure, ensures that convenience is on par with performance.

Starting from an equally premium RM699,000, the Cayenne Electric positions itself firmly in the upper echelons of the luxury performance SUV market. It doesn't merely join its petrol and E-Hybrid siblings; it elevates the entire Cayenne family, offering a zero-emission alternative without compromising on the exhilarating Porsche driving dynamics customers have come to expect. This strategic move underscores Porsche's aggressive push towards an all-electric future, setting a new benchmark for what's possible in the world of high-performance electric vehicles.
keyTakeaways: The Porsche Cayenne Electric is now officially available in Malaysia, expanding Porsche's electric vehicle portfolio.
It is Porsche's third fully electric offering in Malaysia, following the Taycan and Macan EV.
The electric SUV delivers exceptional performance with up to 1,140 hp, over 600km of range, and a starting price from RM699,000.
author: Chief Chapree
